grid.tile: tile = deed·98 + local, origin at the pack grid

fieldsA.by: art-prep/realm/fields-bake.mjs; qc-pack fieldsBake checks it byte for byte against GROUND load()

tone.encoding: rgb = 128 × (lowpass chart / lowpass map colour), clamp 0.5–1.99; water = 128

M2.brief: snow <-> frost tundra with cabbage plots

M4.brief: snow <-> turquoise glacier ice with crevasses (on WILD snow, not ROCK: PACK deviation 2026-09-24 — the painted glacier lake and ice cliffs border snow and water, so an M4 on ROCK collapsed 0.6 % of the lattice)

atlas.rule: family layer = families[M] + mask (0..15); mask 15 may instead take pureUpper[M] first + kitHash(cell) % count (8 variants break the 7-tile repeat)
atlas.wangRule: pureWang[M] = [first, 16] (option-E uppers with props): layer = first + (c(NW)<<3 | c(NE)<<2 | c(SW)<<1 | c(SE)) with c(i,j) = kitHash(i ^ 0x5a1, j ^ 0x2c3) & 1 at lattice vertex (i,j), FORCED to 0 unless the four cells around that vertex are all pure M (so every family/pure boundary is colour 0); seamless for any cell, removes the 7-tile repeat of the classic pick

mask.channels: R = upper class, G = 1-px rim (RGB, no alpha); same grid and mip rows as mapkit.png

recolourReference.spruce: option E spruce (TRUE FOREST = snow + kit scatter/decals)
recolourReference.glacier: option E glacier (TRUE SPECIAL = snow + kit scatter/decals)

keepDprime.M1: fix iteration 2 (critic #2/#7/#9): a closed spruce canopy seen from above is crowns separated by shadow, which the paving metric reads as joint-bounded cells (0.89 / 0.42); the take matches the painting's teal forest (dE 2.6) and passes speckle (0.028); its option E fallback is the black-dot 'TV static' with grid lines the critic flagged (GA2-09)
keepDprime.M2: fix iteration 2: frosted stubble straw strokes score 0.76 at 1:1 but 0 at 1/2 (no joint network at map scale); its option E fallback is the grey/gold crop-grid corduroy (lag-7 0.56)
keepDprime.M4: fix iteration 2: a crevassed glacier is a crackle of ice plates by nature (0.61 / 0.31, under the 1/2 cut); recoloured onto the pale option E glacier (saturation 2.6 -> 1.5); its option E fallback was a flat periwinkle field
